senses.gloss:
दुद् f. (दुत् or दुद्) Anxiety, uneasiness.
 E. दु to give pain, affix क्विप् ।

दुद्द mfn. (-द्दः-द्दा-द्दं)
 1. Giving pain.
 2. Wicked.
 E. दुद्, and द who or
what gives.

दूद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Afflicting, harassing.
 E. दू, and द what gives or
occasions.

दुद्युषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to play with or brandish.
 E. दिव् to play,
desid. form, irr., उ aff.

दुद्रुम m. (-मः) A green onion.
 E. दु bad, द्रुम tree; onions being prohi-
bited food.
